transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because... I've just had this low feeling for a long time now. I mean, I still get through my driving routes, and my volunteer shifts... I get it all done. But there's just this heavy feeling sitting on me most days. Like I'm just... going through the motions, I guess. Not really being in my own life.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or that activities don’t interest you as much as they used to?

I don't know... not really, I guess. I still do my usual stuff on the weekends. Watch a game or whatever. It's not like I stopped liking things. Just... I don't know. Things are just kind of the same.
Do you find that you feel down or hopeless most of the time, even when there’s no clear reason for it?
Yeah... I mean, like I was saying before, it's just that low feeling. Most days are like that. There's no real reason for it, I guess. I still get through my routes fine, it's just... heavy.
Do you often feel tired or like you don’t have any energy, even after resting?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I get tired after a long shift driving, like anyone else, but... I wouldn't say I have no energy. I still get up and do what I need to do.
Do you feel down or experience a low mood most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah... I mean, that's pretty much why I'm here. It's just... for a long time now, most days, I have this heavy, low feeling. Like I said, I still get through my routes, and I do my volunteer shifts, but... it's just sitting on me. I'm just kind of going through the motions, I guess. Not really... in it.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities, even ones you used to enjoy, even if just a little?
No... not really. I still do my usual stuff. I still like the things I normally do, I guess. It's just... what I said before.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt this low for a long time?
No... I don't think so. Never really had anything like this before. Just... just what's been going on lately, I guess.
Have you noticed that you're doing less than usual, or that it takes a lot more effort to get things done, even if you still enjoy them?

Yeah... I guess it does. I mean, I'm still showing up for work, and the pantry. But... it just takes a lot more pushing than it used to. Just to get through it all. 

I even... well, there was this logistics supervisor application I started. I just left it sitting there unfinished. I just... I don't trust myself to keep up with it right now, I guess. So, yeah.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, or do you have trouble sleeping even when you're tired?

My appetite is about the same, I guess. Nothing really different there. 

But sleep... yeah. Specially on nights before a run. I just... I'll just lie there, thinking about all the stops I have to make the next day. Or I'll wake up around four in the morning and that's it, I can't really get back to sleep. So by the time I actually get to work, I just feel... already worn down before the day even starts.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty, maybe even blaming yourself for things more than usual?

I don't know about worthless... but... yeah, I guess I've been hard on myself. 

I just... I think about my dad a lot lately. The kind of man he was. And... well, no one is saying I'm doing a bad job or anything. It's just... in my own head, I guess. I just feel like I should be further along by now. Like I should be able to handle things better than I am. But... I don't know.
Have you ever experienced a period of time before this one where you felt down or low for more than two weeks in a row?
No, I don't... I don't think so. Not that I can remember, anyway. Just... just lately, I guess.
Have you ever had any other episodes in your life where your mood was low and you felt like this, even if they were shorter or not as intense?
Uh... no. Not really. Like I just said, it's really just been lately. Before this stretch... I was just normal, I guess. Nothing really stands out.
Have you ever felt this way before, even for a short time, even if it wasn’t as bad as it is now?
No. Like I just said... no. I don't remember feeling like this before. It's really just been this current stretch. I don't know what else to tell you.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period where you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
Look... didn't you just ask me that? The answer's still no. I haven't had anything like this before. Just this current stretch. I really don't know what else you want me to say about it.
Have you ever had any periods in your life before this current one where you felt down, low, or lost interest in things, even if it was just for a short time or not as severe as now?
I... I really don't know why we keep going over this. I just told you, no. It's just been lately. I don't have anything else to add to that.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for several days in a row, even if it wasn't as bad as what you're experiencing now?
Look, doc... I don't have a different answer for you. It's still no. I never felt like this before. Just... just what's happening right now. I really don't know what else to say about it.
Have you ever had any short periods in your life before this current one where you felt down or lost interest in things, even for just a few days in a row?
I don't know how many different ways I can say it. No. We're just going in circles here.
Have you ever had any brief periods in your life before this one, even just a few days long, where you felt down or lost interest in things?
Still no. I don't know what else you want me to tell you.
Have you ever had any brief periods in your life before this one, even just a few days long, where you felt down or lost interest in things?
Look, man, you've asked me this like four times now. I... I really don't have anything else to give you. The answer is just no. I haven't.
